machinery:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Production sprite atlas for a Victorian steampunk workshop.
Input image: Reference ONLY for visual style, light and materials. Create an entirely new sprite sheet, do not reproduce its architecture or background.
Format: One landscape 3072x2048 image if possible, arranged in exactly 3 columns and 2 rows of equal-sized cells. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with alpha channel. No background color, no checkerboard baked into image. Each of six independent cutouts must sit entirely within its own cell with generous clear transparent padding, all extremities visible. No overlap between cells. No grid, labels, text, floor, cast ground shadow, watermark or UI.
Style: Painterly highly detailed illustrated realism closely matching the reference image. Believable worn materials, sophisticated antique Victorian workmanship, warm directional light from upper left, aged brass, copper and black iron, etched fine detail. No flat cartoon, vector art, simple clipart, or plastic 3D render.
Subjects, exact order:
ROW 1 LEFT: Tall coal furnace, blackened cast iron with ornate brass trim, red glowing arched fire opening, rivets, single ivory circular gauge near upper middle.
ROW 1 MIDDLE: Tall cylindrical copper steam boiler with convex dome, many brass rivet bands, curved pipes, ornate gauge near upper third, glass teal water sight tube lower left, wheel valve lower right; front view, no labels.
ROW 1 RIGHT: Ornate Victorian dark wood and cast iron telegraph desk with brass Morse instrument, paper reel, levers and cables, empty space left on tabletop for a separately added cat. No animal.
ROW 2 LEFT: Small copper and aged ivory dirigible, full side view facing right, ornate suspended gondola WITHOUT pilot, leather ribs, brass fittings, rear propeller. No banner.
ROW 2 MIDDLE: A SINGLE highly detailed brass and iron flywheel cog with exactly centered axle and circular face seen straight-on, all sides visible, radial spokes with transparent gaps.
ROW 2 RIGHT: Hanging Victorian gas lantern, transparent glass showing warm lit flame, ornate dark iron and brass casing, short suspension chain.
No people or animals anywhere.
